images.alt: Diagram shows a flow that describes how new source rows are loaded to a fact table, including the dimension-key lookup and the path where a failed lookup leads to inserting a new, inferred dimension member.
images.credit: Microsoft Learn — Load Tables in a Dimensional Model, Microsoft Fabric documentation

imageNote: Genuine Microsoft-authored diagram exists for the mechanics behind this lesson — the Fabric dimensional-modeling-load-tables page's 'Process fact tables' section includes a real flowchart of the fact-load process, which is exactly where the inferred-member / late-arriving-dimension logic branches off (a failed dimension-key lookup during fact load leads to inserting a placeholder dimension row with IsInferredMember = TRUE). Downloaded and used as the lesson's single screenshot slide. The same page's 'Inferred dimension members' section (prose, no separate diagram) supplied the hotel-loyalty-member example used in the written guide.
